# Data Sources & Attribution

**Raw file:** `gpu_benchmarks_prices_raw.csv`
**Cleaned file:** `gpu_benchmarks_prices_clean.csv` (generated by `src/clean_data.py`)

The raw dataset was sourced from the public GitHub repository
[gradedSystem/GPU_Price_Specs](https://github.com/gradedSystem/GPU_Price_Specs), which compiles
GPU specifications and benchmark scores from PassMark alongside retail prices. Per that repository's
own documentation, the pricing data was originally scraped from [PC Builder](https://pcbuilder.net/product/graphics-card/)
and cross-referenced against a public Kaggle dataset, [GPU Prices Prediction](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/shilongzhuang/gpu-prices-prediction).

This project only uses the data for non-commercial, educational portfolio purposes.

## Columns (raw)

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `gpuName` | GPU model name |
| `G3Dmark` | PassMark 3D benchmark score (higher = faster) |
| `G2Dmark` | PassMark 2D benchmark score |
| `price` | Retail price in USD (many rows are missing this) |
| `gpuValue` | Value score as computed by PassMark (not used — recomputed independently, see below) |
| `TDP` | Thermal Design Power / power draw in watts |
| `powerPerformance` | PassMark's own efficiency metric (not used — recomputed independently) |
| `testDate` | Year the card was released/tested |
| `category` | Desktop / Mobile / Workstation / Unknown |
| `brand` | NVIDIA / AMD / Intel / Apple / Other |

## Columns added during cleaning

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `marks_per_dollar` | `G3Dmark / price` — performance points per dollar (higher = better value) |
| `price_per_mark` | `price / G3Dmark` — dollars per performance point (lower = better value) |
| `performance_per_watt` | `G3Dmark / TDP` — power efficiency |
| `price_tier` | Bucketed price range: Budget / Mid-range / High-end / Enthusiast |
